purpose: Team review artifact: schema of stored and derived player stats used by compare/detail + insights features.

seasonStats.origin: players.player table (season-to-date + Sportmonks season statistics persisted on sync)

formulas.ownership: percentage of fantasy teams whose latest locked squad contains the player
formulas.priceChange: transfer-demand formula using net transfers (ins - outs) per team over lookback window, capped and scaled
formulas.form: average fantasyPoints over the last N fixture snapshots
formulas.performanceIndex: weighted score over the last N fixtures plus per-appearance season support stats (shotsOnTarget/keyPasses per appearance)
